datasets.verbatim: Rainfall data from monitoring stations... We interpolated rainfall data collected by sparse monitoring stations via the inverse distance weighting (IDW) approach

methods.name: Hybrid approach that integrates a random forest (RF) statistical model and a physically based model of transient rainfall infiltration and grid-based regional slope-stability (TRIGRS)
methods.summary: The method integrates a statistical random forest (RF) model, trained on historical landslide data, with a physically based TRIGRS model, which uses real-time rainfall and soil parameters to assess slope stability. The hybrid approach combines the outputs of both models to improve the accuracy of landslide susceptibility mapping.

availability.author_statement: The data are available from the corresponding authors upon reasonable request.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory and other input datasets are not linked or publicly available, and the custom hybrid model code is not provided.
